en: This soap, you see? We made it ourselves.
With herbs Liza from the brewery picked,
we've scented it too.
So once it's washed, see, it smells lovely.
Do you like watching the laundry get done?
Then how about I wash you too?
That ought to perk you up, don't you think?
Freshly washed laundry lined up like this
just feels good to see.
Don't you think so?
What's with the long face, kid?
My name is
I've never worried about my old man,
note: continues in #2122 (slice 026): 'but I do worry about you.'

en: Hm? What's with the long face, kid?
My name is
I'm Wendy, the washerwoman.
It gets cold at night. Take care.
What's with the long face, kid?
Can't you perk up a bit more?
I'm always like this, though...
That's not good,
eat a hearty meal and get your strength up.
Coming to my house won't get you a thing.
I'm fine for now.
I'll ask if I need anything.
Looks like you've worn it for 50 years.
So after washing, see, it smells lovely.
You like watching the washing, huh?
That'd put some life back in you, I'd say.
Seeing laundry hung out to dry like this
feels good. Don't you think so?
Is that you,
What's the matter? At this... hour.
I'm sorry, it's not about laundry,
but I'd like to borrow your strength.
What is it? Go on, tell me.
Well...
I see.
So what do you want me to do?
Please let me bite you.
You're unbelievable, kid.
Is there any human who'd agree to that,
do you think?
You're right, but...
I just can't
note: 'umaku' + 'uso ga tsukenakatta': split 'I just can't' / 'lie well, I mean...'

en: lie well, I mean...
You're a fool, kid.
But I'd guess that's the truth.
Go on, then, bite me.
When this battle ends, a vampire hunter
will surely purify you, I believe.
I am your faithful servant...
Johanna...
Oh dear, when did I hurt myself like this?
I'm Johanna.
Um...
And your name,
won't you tell me?
, is it?
note: ', is it?' repeats the name after it

en: I'm just heading out to the lake
to cut grass.
To run into you so early in the morning,
what luck!
I feel like good things will happen all day.
won't you tell me?
I'm just on my way home.
I knew I'd run into you! Somehow today,
I had a feeling I'd get to see you.
I'm Johanna.
I usually cut grass by the lake.
...That's all?
A "Pleased to meet you,"
note: quoted greeting; #2287 (slice 028) must pair with it as 'wouldn't hurt, you know,'

en: wouldn't hurt, you know,
note: name follows on its own line (' / ' before it) + shared #143 '.'

en: Oh my, back again,
What's the matter,

en: If you need something from me,
